question.problem:
A continuous random variable $X$ has the probability density function 
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/foundations/14133327/assets/f3149524cf7975083139c82369095a564c5cb28e66ecd1bdab94721c64bd6d21.svg)

Calculate $\textrm{E}[X^2].$
question.worked_solution:
For a continuous random variable $X$ with probability density function $f(x)$ defined over a set $S,$ the expected value of $X^2$ is given by

$$
\textrm{E}[X^2] = \int_{S} x^2 \cdot f(x) \,\textrm{d}x.
$$

So, we compute the expected value of $X^2$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{E}[{X}^{2}] & ={\int }_{-2}^{1}{x}^{2}\cdot f(x)\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{-2}^{0}{x}^{2}\cdot \frac{1}{8}\,\text{d}x+{\int }_{0}^{1}{x}^{2}\cdot \frac{3}{2}\,x\,\text{d}x \\  & =\frac{1}{8}{\int }_{-2}^{0}{x}^{2}\,\text{d}x+\frac{3}{2}{\int }_{0}^{1}{x}^{3}\,\text{d}x \\  & =\frac{1}{24}\,{x}^{3}\,{|}_{-2}^{0}+\frac{3}{8}\,{x}^{4}\,{|}_{0}^{1} \\  & =\frac{1}{24}(0+8)+\frac{3}{8}(1-0) \\  & =\frac{1}{3}+\frac{3}{8} \\  & =\frac{17}{24}\end{aligned}
$$
